exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: 20 infants at one year of age
finding: Infants born via spontaneous vaginal delivery have greater viral and bacteriophage diversity in their gut virome at one year of age compared to infants born via cesarean section.
